```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
IntroductionList <- function(values) { 
  Values <- as.character(values)
  if (length(Values) == 1L) return(Values)
  paste(paste(head(Values, -1L), collapse = ", "), tail(Values, 1L), sep = " y ")
}
IntroductionReinforcementPolicy <- Calculation$config$additionalLinings$
  reinforcedConcrete$reinforcementStudy
IntroductionMeshLabels <- vapply(
  IntroductionReinforcementPolicy$reinforcementCases,
  function(Case) paste0("Ø", Case$barDiameterMm, "/", Case$barSpacingMm),
  character(1)
)
IntroductionMeshList <- IntroductionList(IntroductionMeshLabels)
IntroductionSectionGeometry <- list(
  leftUpperHeightM = 3.350,
  leftLowerHeightM = 2.350,
  rightUpperHeightM = 6.650,
  rightLowerHeightM = 4.400
)
IntroductionSectionPressureKPa <- list(
  left =
    IntroductionSectionGeometry$leftUpperHeightM *
      Calculation$stress$upperLayerUnitWeightKnPerM3 +
    IntroductionSectionGeometry$leftLowerHeightM *
      Calculation$stress$effectiveUnitWeightKnPerM3,
  right =
    IntroductionSectionGeometry$rightUpperHeightM *
      Calculation$stress$upperLayerUnitWeightKnPerM3 +
    IntroductionSectionGeometry$rightLowerHeightM *
      Calculation$stress$effectiveUnitWeightKnPerM3,
  adopted =
    Calculation$stress$upperLayerHeightM *
      Calculation$stress$upperLayerUnitWeightKnPerM3 +
    Calculation$stress$coverCrownM *
      Calculation$stress$effectiveUnitWeightKnPerM3
)
```
